Admissions
==========

MISSION-DRIVEN | FORWARD-THINKING | GLOBALLY ENGAGED

Admissions at Wesley Theological Seminary
-----------------------------------------

**Your Calling Deserves a Place to Grow**

At Wesley Theological Seminary (Wesley DC), we prepare you to become transformative leaders for the church and the world. Here, your call meets community at a diverse, faith-filled environment in the heart of Washington, DC, where theological reflection meets public engagement and spiritual formation deepens every aspect of your learning.

Discover Your Path
------------------

Every student’s calling is unique — and so are our degree options. Wesley’s master’s programs are designed to help you grow intellectually, spiritually, and practically, wherever your ministry leads.

**Our Master’s Programs:**

*   **Master of Divinity (MDiv)**: Comprehensive preparation for pastoral ministry, chaplaincy, and leadership in faith communities.
*   **Master of Arts (MA)**: Flexible, focused programs for those seeking theological depth in fields such as the arts, justice, and social transformation.
*   **Master of Theological Studies (MTS)**:  
    An academic, research-focused degree for those seeking deeper understanding of theology, scripture, and the church’s witness in the world — ideal for students preparing for doctoral study or teaching.
*   **Dual Degrees**: In partnership with American University, explore the intersections of theology and policy, peace-building, or international service.

Whether you’re discerning your call or ready to take the next step, Wesley DC provides the guidance, resources, and relationships to help you thrive!

While Wesley’s approach to public theology is distinctly Christian, the Center for Public Theology operates in an environment that is both passionately Christian and compassionately interfaith.

[Contact Us](https://www.wesleyseminary.edu/about/contact-us/)

![](https://www.wesleyseminary.edu/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/Rectangle-19274-3.png)

The Office of Admissions
------------------------

We’re located in the Trott Administration building, Suite 202.

Contact us at [(202)885-8659](tel:(202)885-8659)
 or [admissions@](https://www.wesleyseminary.edu/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#c6a7a2abafb5b5afa9a8b586b1a3b5aaa3bfb5a3abafa8a7b4bfe8a3a2b3)
[wesleyseminary.edu](https://www.wesleyseminary.edu/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#4627222b2f35352f292835063123352a233f35232b2f2827343f68232233)

[**Wesley Theological Seminary**](https://www.wesleyseminary.edu/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#79181d14100a0a1016170a390e1c0a151c000a1c141017180b00571c1d0c)

**Office of Admissions**  
**4500 Massachusetts Avenue, NW**     
**Washington, DC 20016**  
**Our Doctor of Ministry (DMin)**

Take your leadership to the next level through Wesley DC’s Doctor of Ministry (DMin) program, a rigorous and deeply reflective advanced degree designed for experienced ministry professionals.

Our DMin equips pastors, chaplains, and faith-based leaders to engage complex ministry challenges with creativity, courage, and spiritual wisdom. Students design a project that integrates research and practice to strengthen their ministry and contribute to the life of the church and world.

**Program Highlights:**

Designed for working professionals with hybrid online and in-person learning options.

Specialized tracks available in areas such as Public Engagement, Spiritual Leadership, and Chaplaincy.

A culminating project focused on innovation, transformation, and faithful leadership.

 How to Apply

1.  We’re here to walk with you through every step of the admissions process, from discernment to decision.
2.  Start Your Application: Create your account and begin your online application.
3.  Submit Transcripts and Recommendations: We’ll guide you through what’s required for your program.
4.  Schedule a Visit or Virtual Info Session: Experience Wesley DC’s welcoming community firsthand.
5.  Explore Financial Aid and Scholarships: Wesley DC is committed to making theological education accessible and affordable.

**Your Future Begins Here**

At Wesley DC, your studies are more than academic, they are an act of faith. You’ll leave not only with a degree, but with clarity of purpose, a global network of colleagues, and a renewed vision for how to serve God and neighbor.

Join us at Wesley Theological Seminary — where faithful leaders are formed for a changing world!

Eastern Florida State College

Admissions
==========

Pick your student type below and get started!
---------------------------------------------

We customize the enrollment process for [all types of students](https://www.easternflorida.edu/admissions/#types)
 – including those beginning their college experience, high school students wanting a head start, and adults who want to update job skills without seeking a degree.

Start your admissions process early to ensure that you can [meet admissions deadlines](https://www.easternflorida.edu/admissions/deadlines/ "EFSC Admissions Deadlines")
 and complete all of the necessary requirements and provide all of the documents needed to process your application for enrollment as an Eastern Florida State College Titan.

[Limited access programs](https://www.easternflorida.edu/admissions/deadlines/limited-access-programs.php)
, such as health and nursing, public safety, and hands-on workforce programs, may have a special application process in addition to the general EFSC process so check with your program advisor for any additional program-level requirements.

Please note that general application processing can take up to 14 days so plan accordingly. We're here to help so reach out during your enrollment process as many questions can be answered quickly via email.

### Want to get credit for prior learning and certifications?

If you have work, life, or military experience it might translate into college credit, saving you time and money. Our Accelerated Learning coordinator can help you navigate that process as you apply to EFSC. We call it the Life-Experience Acceleration Path or LEAP for short. [Fill out our LEAP form](https://www.easternflorida.edu/registrar/credit-evaluation/leap/leap-form.php "LEAP Form")
 to learn more.

Contact Admissions
------------------

The Admissions Team is available to help you. We have a [list of common resources](https://www.easternflorida.edu/admissions/#resources)
 below plus [an FAQ page](https://www.easternflorida.edu/admissions/faq.php)
. Stop by Campus for walk-in assistance, or [make an appointment](https://www.easternflorida.edu/admissions/contacts.php#appointments)
 to minimize your wait. Prospective students can schedule an on-campus, virtual, or phone appointment using our [Future Student Scheduler](https://outlook.office.com/book/MeetWithARecruitmentSpecialist@titansbrevardcc.onmicrosoft.com/)
 and check our [enrollment events](https://www.easternflorida.edu/admissions/enrollment-events/)

Future StudentsUndergraduate Admissions
---------------------------------------

Whether you’re in high school or thinking about transferring, Barry will give you the tools and experience you need to succeed. Here you will join more than 3,000+ undergraduate students gaining a global perspective by interacting with students and faculty from all over the world in one of the world’s most vibrant cities. We pride ourselves in having a culturally diverse, yet close-knit community where students can flourish by taking advantage of our extensive programs that feature extensive experiential and service learning opportunities.

Looking for that one-on-one attention in the classroom? Barry University provides small class sizes with a low student to faculty ratio (averaging 15:1). Our faculty will ensure you receive the very best, individualized attention throughout your entire academic experience.

[Definition of Common Terms](https://www.barry.edu/en/admissions/undergraduate/definition-of-common-terms/)

 

Transfer Students
-----------------

Already started your college journey? You’re in the right place. At Barry, we make it simple to build on what you’ve already accomplished. From transferring credits to understanding how your previous coursework fits into your degree, our team is here to guide you every step of the way. Whether you’re continuing your path or ready for a fresh start, you’ll find the support you need to transition smoothly and move forward with confidence.

[Learn More](https://www.barry.edu/en/admissions/undergraduate/transfer-admissions/)

Welcome to Chipola College Admissions

At Chipola College, we’re committed to helping you succeed from your first inquiry to graduation day—and beyond. Our dedicated admissions and student services teams are here to guide you every step of the way, ensuring you have the resources, support, and opportunities you need to thrive academically and personally. When you choose Chipola, you’re not just enrolling in a college—you’re joining a caring community that’s invested in your future.

Chipola has an Open Door Admissions Policy which provides educational opportunities to all students 18 years of age or older or high school or GED graduates who are interested in participating in the degree programs, courses, and services offered by the college. Students may enter any Workforce Development Program or the Success Center if it can be shown they could profit by enrollment and attendance. Admission to the college does not imply admission to any particular program or course.

.  **Allow 2 - 3 weeks for processing**.  You are encouraged to apply 6-8 weeks prior to the semester and no later than the application deadline listed in the college calendar to improve your registration opportunities in desired classes and increase your financial aid opportunities.  If you are a returning student, who has not been enrolled at Chipola College for one calendar year or more, you will need to re-apply for admission.

If you plan to enter one of the limited access programs (ADN Nursing, EMT, Paramedic, Corrections, Firefighting, or Law Enforcement) or a bachelor program you must **submit the Supplemental Application** for that specific program by the program application deadline. Admission to the college neither constitutes nor guarantees admission to specific programs.

**All applicants must complete and submit a Residency Declaration.**

 or in the Admissions and Records Office.  Please note that two documents are required to establish residency.  Failure to submit could delay admission into the college and financial aid.  Your residency status will be Non-Resident for Tuition Purposes and you will be charged out-of-state tuition until the Residency Declaration is received and verified by Admissions and Records.  Allow 2–3 weeks for processing.

.  **Final acceptance to the college and/or a** **specific program is contingent on receipt of ALL transcripts.** 

Public high school graduates must request an official transcript be sent after completion of all grades and/or graduation.

 or calling 1-877-352-4331. If the GED is from out-of-state, contact that state’s Department of Education.  

Home school students must complete a Home School Affidavit.

Private school transcripts will be validated on an individual basis.

First time in college students are required to provide official transcripts showing completion high school graduation requirements.  

Returning students who have attended another college(s) since last enrolled at Chipola must provide official final transcripts.

Non-degree students must provide all transcripts.
